## Load the 10X derived sequences :)

```{r loading, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E50.data <- Read10X(filepath_macos)
E50.ADT <- E50.data$`Antibody Capture`
Cells(E50.ADT) %>% length()
# Create Seurat Object using gene expression as main data
E50 = CreateSeuratObject(counts = E50.data$`Gene Expression`, project = "E50", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
# Create "Assay" of the Hashtags and Barcode Oligos
E50[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(E50.data[["Antibody Capture"]][, colnames(x = E50)])

DefaultAssay(E50) <- "RNA"

```

## HTO Hashtag Demultiplex

```{r HTODemultiplex, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# TotalSeqC Hashtag HTO demultiuplexig
E50.ADT <- t(E50.ADT)
E50.ADT <- as.matrix(E50.ADT)
E50.ADT.Hash <- E50.ADT[, c(4, 6, 8, 10)]
E50.ADT.Hash <- t(E50.ADT.Hash)

E50.ADT.Hash.sparse <- as(E50.ADT.Hash, "sparseMatrix")

E50.ADT.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E50.ADT.Hash.sparse, project = "E50", assay = "ADT")
E50_ADT <- NormalizeData(E50.ADT.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)
E50.demux <- HTODemux(E50_ADT, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.99)

E50.demux <- subset(E50.demux, cells = Cells(E50))

E50@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E50.demux@meta.data[["ADT_maxID"]]


# dCODE HTO demultiuplexig
E50.ADT.dCODE <- E50.ADT[, c(1:3)]

E50.ADT.dCODE <-cbind(E50.ADT.dCODE, total = rowSums(E50.ADT.dCODE))

E50.ADT.dCODE <- subset.matrix(E50.ADT.dCODE, E50.ADT.dCODE[, 4] > 0)
E50.ADT.dCODE <- t(E50.ADT.dCODE[, c(1:3)])

E50.ADT.dCODE.sparse <- as(E50.ADT.dCODE, "sparseMatrix")

E50.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E50.ADT.dCODE.sparse, project = "E50", assay = "ADT")
E50.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- NormalizeData(E50.ADT.dCODE.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)

E50.demux.dCODE <- HTODemux(E50.ADT.dCODE.seurat, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.5)

E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["ADT_classification"]]

E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_CA07", "CA07", E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_OVA", "CA07", E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("OVA_PR8", "OVA", E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])


E50 <- subset(E50, cells = Cells(E50.demux.dCODE))
E50.demux.dCODE <- subset(E50.demux.dCODE, cells = Cells(E50))

E50@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E50.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]]

remove(E50.ADT.dCODE, E50.ADT.dCODE.seurat, E50.ADT.dCODE.sparse, E50.ADT.Hash, E50.ADT.Hash.sparse, E50.ADT.seurat, E50.demux, E50.demux.dCODE, E50_ADT, E50.data, E50.ADT)
gc()

```

## 

## Preprocessing of the Gene expression (GEX) data

```{r GEX, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter out based on feature counts
#VlnPlot(E50, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"),ncol = 2)
E50 <- subset(E50, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6500)
#E50

#~~~GENE EXPRESSION~~~
DefaultAssay(E50) <- "RNA"

# Normalize GEX data
E50_GEX <- NormalizeData(E50, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

remove(E50)
# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E50_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E50_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E50_GEX)
E50_GEX <- ScaleData(E50_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E50_GEX <- RunPCA(E50_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E50_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E50_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E50_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E50_GEX, dims = 1:10)
E50_GEX <- FindClusters(E50_GEX, resolution = 0.5)

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E50_GEX <- RunUMAP(E50_GEX, dims = 1:10)

gc()
# Doubletfinder
sweep.E50_GEX <- paramSweep_v3(E50_GEX, PCs = 1:15, sct = T)
sweep.E50_GEX <- summarizeSweep(sweep.E50_GEX, GT = F)
bcmvn_E50_GEX <- find.pK(sweep.E50_GEX)
pk_E50_GEX <- bcmvn_E50_GEX %>% filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>% select(pK)
pk_E50_GEX <- as.numeric(as.character(pk_E50_GEX[[1]]))
(ggplot(bcmvn_E50_GEX, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + theme_classic())

annotations_E50_GEX <- E50_GEX@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homo.prop_E50_GEX <- modelHomotypic(annotations_E50_GEX)
nExp_poi_E50_GEX <- round(0.08*nrow(E50_GEX@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj_E50_GEX <- round(nExp_poi_E50_GEX*(1-homo.prop_E50_GEX))

E50_GEX <- doubletFinder_v3(E50_GEX, PCs = 1:15, pN = 0.25, pK = pk_E50_GEX, nExp = nExp_poi_E50_GEX, reuse.pANN = F, sct = T)


E50_GEX <- subset(E50_GEX, cells=rownames(E50_GEX@meta.data)[which(E50_GEX@meta.data$DF.classification == "Singlet")])

saveRDS(E50_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))

remove(sweep.E50_GEX, bcmvn_E50_GEX, Elbow)
gc()
# ~~~ Re-process the data after doublet removal ~~~
E50_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))
plan("multisession", workers = 1)

# Normalize GEX data
E50_GEX <- NormalizeData(E50_GEX, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E50_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E50_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E50_GEX)
E50_GEX <- ScaleData(E50_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E50_GEX <- RunPCA(E50_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E50_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E50_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E50_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E50_GEX, dims = 1:10)
#E50_GEX <- FindClusters(E50_GEX, resolution = seq(0,1,by = 0.05))

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E50_GEX <- RunUMAP(E50_GEX, dims = 1:9)


E50_GEX <- FindClusters(E50_GEX, resolution = 0.025) #Good resotion for 5 clusters

E50_GEX[["old.idents"]] <- Idents(object = E50_GEX)
DimPlot(E50_GEX)
E50_GEX <- RenameIdents(E50_GEX, '0'='GC B cells', '1' = 'Circulating B cells', '2'="preMBC", '3'="Plasma Blast")

saveRDS(E50_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))
E50_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))

DefaultAssay(E50_GEX) <- "RNA"

E50_GEX.markers <- FindAllMarkers(E50_GEX, only.pos = F, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.2, verbose = F)
top20_E50_GEX <- E50_GEX.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC)
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(E50_GEX, features = top20_E50_GEX$gene, label = T)
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E50_heatmap.svg", sep = ''))

remove(E50_GEX.markers, top20_E50_GEX)

saveRDS(E50_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Continue with the processing of Hashtag/Barcode (ADT) data

```{r ADT, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
E50_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
DefaultAssay(E50_GEX) <- "ADT"

# Normalize ADT data
E50_ADT <- NormalizeData(E50_GEX, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2)

# Find highly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E50_ADT <- FindVariableFeatures(E50_ADT, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)


# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E50_ADT@assays[["ADT"]])
E50_ADT <- ScaleData(E50_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the ADT
E50_ADT <- RunPCA(E50_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Find dimensionality of ADT dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E50_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
Elbow

E50_ADT <- RunUMAP(E50_ADT, assay = 'ADT', dims = 1:4)
DimPlot(E50_ADT, group.by = "Hashtag")
DimPlot(E50_ADT)
# Clustering and...→
E50_ADT <- FindNeighbors(E50_ADT, dims = 1:5)
#E50_ADT <- FindClusters(E50_ADT, resolution = seq(0, 1 , by = 0.05))

#clustree(E50_ADT)
E50_ADT <- FindClusters(E50_ADT, resolution = 0.01) #Maybe good cluster amount??
E50_ADT <- RenameIdents(E50_ADT, '0'='PBS-CA07', '1' = 'PR8-CA07', '2'='PBS-PBS', '3'='CA07-CA07')


ADT_plot <- DimPlot(E50_ADT, pt.size = 0.2, group.by = "Hashtag") + theme(aspect.ratio=1)
ADT_plot <- ADT_plot + ggtitle('Hashtag/Bardoce clustering')
ADT_plot
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Cluster.svg', sep = ''), ADT_plot)

plot2 <- FeaturePlot(E50_ADT, features = E50_dCODE, pt.size = 0.2, keep.scale = 'all', order = TRUE) & theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plot2

p3 <- FeaturePlot(E50_ADT, features = E50_group, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 6), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
p3

saveRDS(E50_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Merging Seurat with BCR contig using scRepertoire

```{r scRepertoire, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E50_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E50_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Loading Contig file
E50_contigs <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/2_Ig_all_filtered_contigs/mouse_scseq_rep2_contigs.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t" )

E50_clonotypes <- E50_contigs

# Renaming MiXCR contig output to match 10X cellranger filtered contig annotations
E50_clonotypes <- E50_clonotypes %>% 
  mutate(chain = E50_clonotypes$chains) %>% 
  mutate(barcode = paste(E50_clonotypes$tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = "")) %>% 
  mutate(reads = E50_clonotypes$readCount) %>% 
  mutate(v_gene = E50_clonotypes$bestVGene) %>% 
  mutate(d_gene = E50_clonotypes$bestDGene) %>% 
  mutate(j_gene = E50_clonotypes$bestJGene) %>% 
  mutate(c_gene = E50_clonotypes$bestCGene)

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR1"] = "fwr1_nt"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR2"] = "fwr2_nt"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR3"] = "fwr3_nt"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR4"] = "fwr4_nt"

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1_nt"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2_nt"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3_nt"

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR1"] = "fwr1"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR2"] = "fwr2"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR3"] = "fwr3"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR4"] = "fwr4"

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2"
colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3"

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "uniqueUMICount"] = "umis"

colnames(E50_clonotypes)[colnames(E50_clonotypes) == "targetSequences"] = "length"

E50_clonotypes <- E50_clonotypes %>% group_by(barcode) %>% mutate(contig_id=paste(barcode, "_contig_", row_number(), sep = ""))



E50_clono.E50_test <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/E50/E50 VDJ_B/filtered_contig_annotations.csv")

#Adding contig BCR information to ADT seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E50_clonotypes, E50_ADT, group.by = "orig.ident")

combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85, removeNA = TRUE)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E50_ADT <- combineExpression(combined, E50_ADT, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E50_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E50_ADT@active.ident)

slot(E50_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E50_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

saveRDS(E50_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Adding contig BCR information to GEX seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E50_clonotypes, E50_GEX, group.by = "orig.ident")


combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E50_GEX <- combineExpression(combined, E50_GEX, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E50_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E50_GEX@active.ident)

slot(E50_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E50_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

# Highlighting clonotypes
Selected_clones <- c("CARPRGYGPFDYW_CQNDYAYPLTF","CARSYGCCYEVAYW_CQQYYSYPWTF", "CARSRGYFDYW_CQQDYSSPYTF", "CARNYGNSPFAYW_CQHFWSTPFTF")

E50_ADT <- highlightClonotypes(E50_ADT, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
E50_ADT_selected_clones <- DimPlot(E50_ADT, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
                              theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
                              scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

E50_GEX <- highlightClonotypes(E50_GEX, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
E50_GEX_selected_clones <- DimPlot(E50_GEX, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
                                  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
                                  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E50_ADT_selected_clones.svg", sep = ""), plot = E50_ADT_selected_clones)
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E50_GEX_selected_clones.svg", sep = ""), plot = E50_GEX_selected_clones)

saveRDS(E50_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
saveRDS(E50_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Plotting with scRepertoire

```{r ChordDiagram, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
E50_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E50_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E50-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E50_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E50_ADT@active.ident)

grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E50_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E50_GEX@active.ident)


# Ova removed E50_testing
E50_ADT.noOVA <- subset(E50_ADT, HA_binding != "OVA")
circles.E50_ADT.noOVA <- getCirclize(E50_ADT.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
chord <- circlize::chordDiagram(circles.E50_ADT.noOVA,
                       self.link = 1,
                       directional = 1,
                       symmetric = TRUE,
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on HA bindng
circles.ADT.HA <- getCirclize(E50_ADT, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.HA,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Experimental groups
circles.ADT.ident <- getCirclize(E50_ADT, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Cell clusters
circles.GEX.ident <- getCirclize(E50_GEX, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.GEX.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Clonal expansion overlayed on ADT clustering
DimPlot(E50_ADT, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")), 
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) &
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion overlayed on GEX clustering
DimPlot(E50_GEX, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 0.5) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")),
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion network overlayed on ADT clustering
clonalNetwork(E50_ADT, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Clonal expansion network overlayed on GEX clustering
clonalNetwork(E50_GEX, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Number of cells binned by clonal expansion by HA binding, GEX cluster, and ADT cluster
p1 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E50_GEX, x.axis = "HA_binding")
p2 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E50_GEX, x.axis = "ident")
p3 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E50_ADT, x.axis = "ident")

(p1 + NoLegend() | p2 + NoLegend() | p3) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 12))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)


combined.ADT <- expression2List(E50_ADT, 
                             split.by = "Hashtag")
combined.GEX <- expression2List(E50_GEX, 
                             split.by = "ident")
### Relative abundance
p1 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.ADT, 
                  cloneCall = "strict", group.by = "Hashtag")
p2 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.GEX, 
                  cloneCall = "strict")
(p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Occupied Reperoire space
p1 <- clonalProportion(combined.ADT, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
p2 <- clonalProportion(combined.GEX, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
clonalpropotionplot <- (p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)
clonalpropotionplot


### CLonal overlap
p1 <- clonalOverlap(combined.ADT, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
p2 <- clonalOverlap(combined.GEX, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
(p1 | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 15), axis.text = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)

```

## Manual mutation count on nucleotide level

```{r manualMutation, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
pattern <- "[SN][ACTGN][0-9]{2,3}[ACTGN]"

E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR1[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR1)] <- 0
E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR2[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR2)] <- 0
E50_contigs$nMutationsFR1[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR1)] <- 0
E50_contigs$nMutationsFR2[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR2)] <- 0
E50_contigs$nMutationsFR3[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR3)] <- 0
E50_contigs$nMutationsFR4[is.na(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR4)] <- 0

E50_contigs$totnMutationsCDR <- str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsCDR2, pattern = pattern)

E50_contigs$totnMutationsFR <-  str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR2, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR3, pattern = pattern) +
                                str_count(E50_contigs$nMutationsFR4, pattern = pattern)


## Mergin Contig mutations with Seurat object:

Cells(E50_GEX) %>% length()

E50_GEX@meta.data[["HC_FWR_mut"]] <- E50_mutationList.HC.GEX$totnMutationsFR

E50_ADT@meta.data[["LC_FWR_mut"]] <- E50_mutationList.LC.ADT$totnMutationsFR

E50_ADT@meta.data[["MutClass"]] <- ifelse(E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 1 , "0",
                                    ifelse(E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 0 & E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 10, "1-10",
                                    ifelse(E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 9 & E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 20, "11-20", 
                                    ifelse(E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 19 & E50_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 30, "21-30", ">30"))))
```

```{r}
Bulk <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_bulk.RDS")
SingleCell <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_sc.RDS")
```
